readings: For each transaction in `sentimentandfundamentals` (`transref`), take the average analyst coverage count (`anlycount`, ignoring missing values). Keep only the transactions whose average is above the overall average of those per-transaction averages. For each one, show `transref`, its average, how far it is above that overall average, and how far it is above the average among just the kept transactions. Sort by that last difference, highest first (missing last), and return the top 10 rows plus every other row tied with the 10th. Don't round.
queries:
WITH per_tx AS (
  SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_cnt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY transref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS overall_avg FROM per_tx
),
kept AS (
  SELECT p.transref, p.avg_cnt, o.overall_avg
  FROM per_tx p, overall o
  WHERE p.avg_cnt > o.overall_avg
),
kept_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS k_avg FROM kept
),
result AS (
  SELECT k.transref,
         k.avg_cnt AS avg_anlycount,
         k.avg_cnt - k.overall_avg AS diff_overall,
         k.avg_cnt - ka.k_avg AS diff_kept
  FROM kept k, kept_avg ka
)
SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, diff_overall, diff_kept
FROM result
WHERE diff_kept IS NOT NULL AND (
  SELECT COUNT(*) FROM result r WHERE r.diff_kept > result.diff_kept
) < 10
OR diff_kept IS NULL AND (
  SELECT COUNT(*) FROM result r WHERE r.diff_kept IS NOT NULL OR (r.diff_kept IS NULL AND 0)
) < 10
ORDER BY diff_kept DESC
